concepts.def: Primary school years 1–4 (years 1–6 in Berlin and Brandenburg).
Academic secondary school leading to the Abitur after year 12 or 13.
Other secondary tracks; many states now offer integrated Gesamtschulen.
School-leaving qualification giving access to university; Allgemeine Hochschulreife.
Apprenticeship system combining classroom learning with workplace training.
an, in, auf, vor — accusative for direction, dative for location.
